'''December 2001 Melbourne tournament (9 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 9 December 2001. [[Luca Costanzo]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3161">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-melbourne-oz-9-12-01d3161/ melbourne-oz-9-12-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 12 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-melbourne-oz-9-12-01d3161/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Luca Costanzo]]
